steps.note: Inspect. The records in scope are listed, and any skipped file is reported.
Partition. The records are cut into chunks, each read on its own.
Map. Each chunk is checked against this skill's rules, one chunk at a time.
Rank. Each signal is placed by its source, and a private or personal detail is removed.
Verify. Each cited line is re-read, and a finding that does not hold is dropped.
Report. Status: draft for the owner to review. It is not a decision.

findings.title: Signal uses a private or personal detail
findings.fix: Remove the detail and keep the public fact

example:
Illustrative example: the items and results are made up, not real output.
Summary: 3 findings (1 high, 1 medium, 1 low).
[high] signal-private.md:12  Signal uses a private or personal detail.
       Fix: Remove the detail and keep the public fact.
[medium] signal-press.md:19  Signal with no public source.
       Fix: Name the public source.
[low] signal-event.md:26  Signal not dated.
       Fix: Date the signal.
Not checked: Whether the signal is real.
pros: Checks a signal with no public source, and a signal that uses a private or personal detail.
cons: Not checked: Whether the signal is real.
input: The records for this review, as text or CSV
output: A draft report: findings with location, fix and a not-checked list
prompt: Use the rlm-hrc-competitor-hiring-watch skill on the records for this review.
